Q: How do you install an APK file in the Android emulator? A:

Download the APK file from the Internet and copy it to platform-tools of your SDK folder. Then in a command prompt, go to that directory and type:

adb install filename.apk

Press Enter. It will install in a few seconds.

Q: Sending an Intent to a browser to open a specific URL A:

From XML

In case if you have the web-address/URL displayed on your view and you want it to make it clickable and direct user to particular website You can use:

android:autoLink="web"

In the same way, you can use different attributes of autoLink(email, phone, map, all) to accomplish your task...

Q: Can I set the dimensions of a screen capture in QuickTime Player 10 A:

unless I've misunderstood the question... what I do is select "new screen recording" & a small box appears. the pulldown next to the record button lets you choose an audio source- you may need loopback or something similar to get this to appear at all, & then to select your required audio source (or 'none'). the meters will start to move, & there's a slider to adjust the monitor levels (in loopback, you can mute the source's direct audio so that what you hear is via quicktime).

then press the red button & a new bit of instruction appears- click to record the whole screen or drag a box around the target (you can resize this however you want!), then press 'start recording'.

to end the capture, ctrl-apple-esc, save yr movie how & where you want.

Q: Node JS how to limit maximum number of sockets A:

The default maxSockets value is Infinity and it determines the limit of number of sockets per host. See official docs: https://nodejs.org/api/http.html#http_agent_maxsockets

You can manually set maxSockets limit using the following code snippet

require('http').globalAgent.maxSockets = 10

globalAgent: Global instance of Agent which is used as the default for all HTTP client requests.
